audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagreed with the packet chart and with their own whys: win[0] said Skill while whys[0] says 'concede the level'; win[1] said Tryndamere while whys[1] ends "it's a wash"; win[2] and win[3] said Tryndamere/Skill while the whys describe your combo landing and your bulk banking leads; win[5] said Tryndamere while whys[5] says 'neither stomps'.
audit.why: Tryndamere owns level 1 with spin-farm and crit autos, loses 3-5 to a tank he must walk into, and reclaims the game on crit items.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Tryndamere (4/10), Level 2 = Skill, Level 3 and Levels 4-5 = K'Sante (6/10), First item = Skill, in matched pairs.

audit.why: Lvl 1, Lvl 3, Lvl 6 and late are the right beats; level 6 correctly reads as a trap rather than a spike because Undying Rage answers the burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (a) 'W eats his E gap-close as unstoppable' and 'W's unstoppable charge' — Path Maker's text says only 'taking reduced damage'. (b) 'Spin (Q)' credits the dash to Bloodlust; the spin is Spinning Slash (E, 12/11/10/9/8s) and Q is the Fury-consuming heal. (c) 'use R to recall him off your carry' — K'Sante's R launches the target through a wall and dashes after them; there is no recall.
audit.why: Spinning Slash's 12-second cooldown at rank 1 is the actual thing to trade around, and it is the number that makes the advice concrete. Naming Q as the spin also hides that Q is the heal you need Grievous Wounds for.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected, 12s stated, unstoppable and recall removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is called core in the full layer but never appears in the content layer, where the late-game plan is written.
audit.why: Bloodlust converts his Fury into healing on a 12s cooldown, so an extended trade without Grievous Wounds resets to zero for him.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into whys[6], spikes[3] and late.

edits.before: Level 1 belongs to him — he spins to last-hit and chips you with crit autos while you only have Q and no engage. Don't step up to throw a Q he can just walk through; farm at the tip of Q and eat a little poke. Once you hit 3 your Q-W combo flips it: bait his E gap-close, W-charge to become unstoppable through it, then Q3 to knock him up. His Fury bar is the tell — if it's full, he wants you to commit so he can E in and spin you down, so trade when it's low.
edits.after: Level 1 belongs to him — he spins to last-hit and chips you with crit autos while you only have Q and no engage. Don't step up to throw a Q he can just walk through; farm at the tip of Q and eat a little poke. Once you hit 3 your Q-W combo flips it: bait Spinning Slash, W him for the knockback stun as he lands, then Q3-pull him back in. His Fury bar is the tell — if it's full, he wants you to commit so he can spin in and crit you down, so trade when it's low.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are yours. He has to walk into your range to do damage, so you trade around his E cooldown — W his dash, Q3 against a wall, and bank the bulk lead as a tank. Level 6 is a trap: All Out gives you a duelist profile but strips your armor right when his R Undying Rage makes him immortal for 5 seconds, so a full-commit ult into a topped-up Tryndamere just feeds him a free spin-down. Ult to peel or to finish him at low Fury, not to out-DPS a fresh Undying Rage.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are yours. He has to walk into your range to do damage, so you trade around Spinning Slash's 12-second cooldown — W his dash, Q3-pull him back, and bank the bulk lead as a tank. Level 6 is a trap: All Out gives you a duelist profile but strips your armour right when Undying Rage makes him immortal for 5 seconds, so a full-commit ult into a topped-up Tryndamere just feeds him a free spin-down. Ult to peel or to finish him at low Fury, not to out-DPS a fresh R.

edits.before: This is where he reclaims it. Two crit items in, Tryndamere spin-kites your short-range Q and W, and his R Undying Rage simply outlasts any burst your All Out can muster — you can't kill a man who survives at 1 HP for 5 seconds while critting you back. Stop trying to win the side-lane 1v1. Your value is R: dash through him and recall to drag him off your carry, then let your team collapse. Win on your earlier mid-game windows, because the very late solo duel is his.
edits.after: This is where he reclaims it. Two crit items in, Tryndamere spin-kites your short-range Q and W, and Undying Rage simply outlasts any burst All Out can muster — you can't kill a man who survives at 1 HP for 5 seconds, and Bloodlust heals the rest unless Grievous Wounds is on him. Stop trying to win the side-lane 1v1. Your value is R: launch him through a wall away from your carry, then let your team collapse. Win on your earlier mid-game windows.

edits.after: Use W's damage-reduced charge to punish his Spinning Slash, then Q3-pull him back in

edits.after: Spin in with Spinning Slash (E) to last-hit safely and stack crit autos on you
